heuristics.name: likely-headword back-inference
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is the common plain-English gloss for a recognisable ISEE-level headword (e.g. postpone<-defer, impede<-hinder, fleeting<-transient), distractors being unrelated everyday words

heuristics.name: phrase-option definition fit
heuristics.description: For phrase options, pick the one that defines a single classic vocabulary word (unwilling to spend=stingy, thinly scattered=sparse, quick to recover=resilient)

heuristics.name: arbitrary
heuristics.description: No discernible signal; picked one of the plausible options

notes: No option set contained a clear one-option tell; picks are guesses grounded in which option is the canonical gloss of a typical test headword. reject_certain is false everywhere.
